title: G0 Approval Reference
description: Executable approval record contract. An approval satisfies a capability's required approval class ONLY by an explicit rule: AP2 requires an AP2 approval; AP3 requires AP3 from two distinct human principals; AP1 can NEVER satisfy AP2/AP3; APX is unsatisfiable. No implicit class inheritance exists.

approver_principal.description: Human principal id. Agents may NEVER appear here (LAW-B1-018).

co_approver_principal.description: Required distinct second principal for AP3.

approval_class.description: Must EXACTLY match the capability's required class. APX cannot be approved; AP0 needs no record.

scope_project_id.description: Tenant-scoped by default (null). When set, this approval authorizes ONLY that project; a project-scoped approval can never authorize another project. The evaluator rejects any approval whose scope_project_id differs from the request's project_id.

subject_capability_id.description: REQUIRED. The capability this approval was granted for. An approval for capability A can never satisfy capability B.

decided_at.description: REQUIRED. ISO-8601 decision timestamp; must parse and must not be in the future.

expires_at.description: When present, MUST be later than the evaluation time; an expired timestamp fails even if status is still VALID.
